violations.why: irq_vine (higher priority) can preempt irq_shoal between its write of 0 and the check, setting -1 so the check fails.
Higher-priority ermine/crest/kiln run fn_jade between irq_grove's reset to -1 and its test, so the test sees a different value.
irq_grove (higher than shoal) can write v_marble between the two reads in fn_north.
irq_grove can write v_ivory between the two reads in fn_north called from irq_shoal.
irq_kiln (higher than crest) overwrites v_knoll[9000] between crest's write and its read.
irq_ermine, which has higher priority, can set v_meadow to 0 between vine's write of -1 and its check.
irq_crest can preempt irq_vine and set v_meadow to 0 before the check.
irq_kiln can preempt irq_vine and set v_meadow to 0 before the check.
